facts.fact: ZABS states on its own site that it develops, publishes, maintains or withdraws Zambian National Standards, has developed standards in sectors including Information Communication Technology, and counts 6,500+ Zambian National Standards and 50+ international standards adopted as ZS; the page has no date, so the published date 2026-08-29 is used.

note: The page lists product and systems certification generically, not against an IT or data standard, and names no certifier for one, so no certification fact.
